scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Ah, I sense you have endured
a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
啊，我能感覺到，你經歷過前世。
進入瓦爾哈拉之前，你一定學到了許多東西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Unfortunately, I don't think you're ready to become an Acolyte yet. Please finish learning all of the Basic Skills first.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
很遺憾，我覺得你還沒準備好成為服事。
請先學會所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
In the meantime,
I will wait until
you are ready.
May God be
with you.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
我會在這裡等你準備好。
願上帝與你同在。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I welcome you
back from Valhalla and
wish you luck on your
new life's journey.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
歡迎你從瓦爾哈拉歸來。
願你在新的人生旅途中一切順利。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth and seek those who need your help. May God light your path.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
現在，出發去尋找那些需要幫助的人吧。
願上帝照亮你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth to seek people who need your help. May God enlighten your way.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
現在，出發去尋找那些需要幫助的人吧。
願上帝指引你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I sense that you have endured a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
我能感覺到，你經歷過前世。
進入瓦爾哈拉之前，你一定學到了許多東西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
However, I can tell that you are not suited to be an Acolyte. Please remember who you were in your past life and find your path.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
然而，我能看出你不適合成為服事。
請銘記你前世的身份，找到屬於你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
What is it that you seek?
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你所尋求的是什麼？

scripts.text: Father, I want to be a Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 神父，我想成為服事

scripts.text: Acolyte Requirements.
scripts.translation: 成為服事的條件

scripts.text: Just looking around.
scripts.translation: 只是隨便看看

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Are you feeling okay today? I can tell by your attire that you are already an Acolyte. You're not joking around, are you?
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你今天還好嗎？
看你的裝束，你已經是服事了。
你不是在開玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I'm sorry, but we can only accept Novices as applicants for the job change to Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
很抱歉，我們只接受初心者申請轉職為服事。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you truly
wish to become
a servant of God?
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你真的願意成為上帝的僕人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Oh, you've come back. Let me check and see if you are ready to serve God. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
哦，你回來了。
讓我看看你是否已經準備好侍奉上帝...
嗯...

scripts.text: Yes Father, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，神父，我願意

scripts.text: Nope, I lied.
scripts.translation: 不，我騙你的

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Good. I accept {0}'s will to become an Acolyte. You understand that you must do penance before you can become a servant of God, right?
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
很好，{0}，我接受你成為服事的志願。
你明白，在成為上帝的僕人之前，必須先完成苦修，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I will
give you a mission...
Please visit ^000077Father Rubalkabara^000000, a member of the Prontera Parish, and return here. He has been practicing asceticism in the ^000077Relics NorthEast of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
那麼，我給你一個任務...
請去拜訪普隆德拉教區的^000077魯巴爾卡巴拉神父^000000，然後回來。
他正在^000077普隆德拉城東北方的遺蹟^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I will
give you a mission...
Please visit ^000077Mother Mathilda^000000 and then return to me. She has been practicing asceticism near ^000077Morocc Town, SouthWest of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
那麼，我給你一個任務...
請去拜訪^000077瑪蒂爾達修女^000000，然後回來找我。
她正在^000077普隆德拉城西南方的夢羅克鎮附近^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I will
give you a mission...
Please visit ^000077Father Yosuke^000000 and return here. He has been practicing asceticism around ^000077a bridge somewhere NorthWest of Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
那麼，我給你一個任務...
請去拜訪^000077陽介神父^000000，然後回來。
他正在^000077普隆德拉西北方某座橋附近^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
May the grace of God light your path and guide you during your journey of penance.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
願上帝的恩典照亮你的道路，指引你完成苦修之旅。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
You lied?
It is good that you
have confessed your
wrongdoing. Go in
peace, my son.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你撒謊了？
能坦白自己的過錯，是件好事。
平安地去吧，我的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Good Lord! Haven't you accomplished the Basic Training yet?! It's important that you finish that!
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
天哪！
你還沒完成基礎訓練嗎？！
完成訓練很重要！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Oh? I can't find your name on the Registration List.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
哦？
我在報名名單上找不到你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Hmm...
Your name is on the list and you've proven your qualification.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
嗯...
你的名字在名單上，也已經證明自己具備資格了。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
You should have trained more! Go back and make sure you reach Novice Job Level 9 and learn all of the Basic Skills!
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你還需要多加訓練！
回去把初心者的職業等級練到9級，並學會所有基本技能！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please visit ^000077Father Rubalkabara^000000, a member of the Prontera Parish, and return here.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
請去拜訪普隆德拉教區的成員^000077魯巴爾卡巴拉神父^000000，然後回來。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He has been practicing asceticism in the ^000077Relics at the NorthEast of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
他正在^000077普隆德拉城東北方的遺蹟^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please Visit ^000077Mother Mathilda^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
請去拜訪^000077瑪蒂爾達修女^000000，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
She has been practicing asceticism near ^000077Morocc Town, located SouthWest of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
她正在^000077普隆德拉城西南方的夢羅克鎮附近^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please visit ^000077 Father Yosuke ^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
請去拜訪^000077 陽介神父 ^000000，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He has been practicing asceticism near a ^000077bridge somewhere to the NorthWest of Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
他正在^000077普隆德拉西北方某座橋附近^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
May the grace of God brighten your path and guide you on your journey of penance.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
願上帝的恩典照亮你的道路，指引你完成苦修之旅。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I am proud to say that you are now ready to become an Acolyte!
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
我很自豪地告訴你，你現在已經準備好成為服事了！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Always remember to be thankful to God, who is taking care of us all the time.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
要時刻心懷感恩，上帝始終照顧著我們。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Always use your gifts to serve Him by helping others. In chaos and times of difficulty, face your hardships with unwavering faith.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
要運用自己的天賦幫助他人，以此侍奉上帝。
即使身處混亂與困境，也要以堅定不移的信仰面對苦難。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Lastly, I want to sincerely congratulate you on persevering through your trial of penance.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
最後，衷心祝賀你堅持完成了苦修的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you wish to become an Acolyte? You must fulfill two requirements.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你想成為服事嗎？
你必須滿足兩個條件。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
First, you have to reach at least Novice Job Level 9 and learn all of the Basic Skills. Second, you will be given a trial of penance to overcome.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
首先，初心者的職業等級必須達到9級以上，並學會所有基本技能。
其次，你必須通過苦修的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
For your trial, please visit ^000077Father Rubalkabara ^000000 and then return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你的考驗是去拜訪^000077魯巴爾卡巴拉神父 ^000000，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
For your trial, please visit ^000077Mother Mathilda^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你的考驗是去拜訪^000077瑪蒂爾達修女^000000，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
For your trial, please visit ^000077Father Yosuke^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你的考驗是去拜訪^000077陽介神父^000000，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
The destination for this trial will be decided once you fill the application form.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
等你填好申請表，就會確定這次考驗的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He is practicing asceticism in the ^000077Relics at the NorthEast of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
他正在^000077普隆德拉城東北方的遺蹟^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
She has been practicing asceticism near ^000077Morocc, located to the SouthWest of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
她正在^000077普隆德拉城西南方的夢羅克附近^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He has been practicing asceticism around a bridge somewhere ^000077NorthWest of Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
他正在^000077普隆德拉西北方^000000某座橋附近苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
May the grace of God light your path and guide you on your journey of penance.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
願上帝的恩典照亮你的道路，指引你完成苦修之旅。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please come back after fulfilling the two requirements I've asked of you. As long as your desire to serve God and others is sincere, you will be able to make it.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
滿足我提出的兩個條件後，再回來吧。
只要你真心願意侍奉上帝、幫助他人，就一定能做到。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Please take care. They should know that you've met me by the time you arrive at the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
路上小心。
等你回到普隆德拉聖堂，他們應該就知道你已經見過我了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...? You must be the one who aspires to become an Acolyte. I've already received news from the Sanctuary that you might be coming.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
哦...？
你就是想成為服事的那個人吧。
聖堂已經來信，說你可能會來。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...
Are you one of the
Acolyte applicants...?
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
哦...
你是申請成為服事的人嗎...？
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Huh? What brings you here? This is a very dangerous place for a Novice like yourself!
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
咦？
你怎麼來這裡了？
對你這樣的初心者來說，這裡很危險！

scripts.text: [Father Rubalkabara]
scripts.translation: [魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Greetings.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh ho...
Have you come into the Deep here for training? Or are you just a Wanderer?
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
哦呵...
你深入這裡是為了修行，還是隻是四處遊歷？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I've sent a carrier pigeon with a message. I hope it will arrive there safely...
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
我已經用信鴿傳了訊息。
希望它能平安抵達...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Now, your name was {0}, right? Excellent, thank you for visiting me.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
你叫{0}，對吧？
很好，謝謝你來看我。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I believe you've been told much about Acolytes from Friar Mareusis. Plus, there's plenty of helpful people in the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
我想馬魯西斯神父已經向你介紹了不少關於服事的事情。
普隆德拉聖堂裡也有許多樂於助人的人。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I guess there's really no need for me to teach you much. Besides, I'm sure your someone from your generation may have trouble listening to an old man like me. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
我想，也沒多少東西需要我來教你了。
況且，你們這代年輕人，恐怕不太聽得進去我這個老頭子的話吧。
哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Still, lessons may come from the places you'd least expect. God loves to teach his children in strange ways. You'll see.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
不過，有時你會從最意想不到的地方學到東西。
上帝喜歡用奇妙的方式教導祂的孩子。
你會明白的。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Well, I'll send the message telling them that you've come to visit me. So, you may now return to the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
好了，我會傳訊息，告訴他們你來拜訪過我。
現在可以回普隆德拉聖堂了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
再見。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Your name is {0}?
I don't think your name
is on my list. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
你叫{0}？
我的名單上好像沒有你的名字。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Why don't you go back to the Prontera Sanctuary and check again?
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
你不如回到普隆德拉聖堂再確認一下吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Welcome to the Deep. Feel free to sit and contemplate God's message with me. This place is beautiful, even if danger accompanies its sense of serenity...
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
歡迎來到這片幽深之地。
不妨坐下來，和我一起思索上帝的教誨。
這裡很美，雖然寧靜之中也潛藏著危險...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Whoever you are, please take care of yourself. The monsters in here are shockingly strong, contrary to their cute appearance.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
無論你是誰，都請小心。
這裡的魔物外表可愛，實力卻強得驚人。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a carrier pigeon to the Prontera Sanctuary. When you return, the Priest there should already have received my message.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
我會用信鴿給普隆德拉聖堂傳訊息。
等你回到那裡，牧師應該已經收到訊息了。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah, you must be one of the Acolyte applicants. I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
啊，你一定是申請成為服事的人吧。
誠摯地歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah...!
You must be one
of the Acolyte applicants.
I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
啊...！
你一定是申請成為服事的人吧。
誠摯地歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
...
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
...

scripts.text: [Mother Mathilda]
scripts.translation: [瑪蒂爾達修女]

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hello there~
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
May God
be with you...
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
願上帝與你同在...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will pray to God, and hope that you become an Acolyte soon.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
我會向上帝祈禱，希望你能早日成為服事。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
What is your name? {0}? Let's see... Ah, you're on my list.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
你叫什麼名字？
{0}？
讓我看看...
啊，你在我的名單上。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a message to the Sanctuary confirming that you, {0} visited me and completed your penance.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
我會通知聖堂，確認{0}已經拜訪過我，完成了苦修。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Please return to the Prontera Sanctuary and speak to the Priest in charge.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
請回普隆德拉聖堂，找負責此事的牧師談談。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Now, what is your name?
{0}? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
你叫什麼名字？
{0}？
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hmm...
It seems your name
is not on my list...
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
嗯...
看來，你的名字不在我的名單上...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Perhaps you should return to the Prontera Sanctuary and check the destination for your penance trial once again.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
也許你該回普隆德拉聖堂，再確認一下苦修考驗的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
How is your practice coming along? I certainly hope you're enjoying living in the grace of God.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
你的修行進展如何？
願你在上帝的恩典中生活得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
What?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
Whatever you are,
you look like an
Acolyte applicant.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
嘿，不管你是誰，看起來倒像是來申請當服事的。
對吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
You look like an Acolyte Applicant. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
嘿，你是來申請當服事的吧？
我說得對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You...
Novice.
There something
you wanna tell me?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
你...初心者。
有什麼話想跟我說？

scripts.text: [Father Yosuke]
scripts.translation: [陽介神父]

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey...
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
嘿...

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Do you have anything to say? Because unfortunately for you,
I don't any replies.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
你有什麼話要說嗎？
可惜，我沒什麼可回答你的。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Have you any more business with me?! You don't! Go back to the Sanctuary now!
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
你還有事找我嗎？！
沒有了吧！
快回聖堂去！

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad, not bad. You withstood the penance trial pretty well.
So what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
不錯，不錯，苦修的考驗你完成得很好。
你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
{0}，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Okay. I'll send a message to the Sanctuary that you, {0}, came to visit me.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
好，我會通知聖堂，說{0}已經來拜訪過我了。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Now go back to the Santuary and finish becoming an Acolyte, kid.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
孩子，快回聖堂去，完成服事的轉職吧。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad at all, you've made it all the way here from Prontera. So what's your name, kid?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
不錯嘛，孩子，你從普隆德拉一路走到這裡了。
你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh? Why isn't your name on my list?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
{0}，是吧？
怎麼名單上沒有你的名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You probably made a mistake. Go back to the Santuary, and check with the Bishop.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
你大概搞錯了。
回聖堂找主教確認一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
If you like, come sit here with me and meditate the great truths. God's majesty is truly inspiring...
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
願意的話，就坐下來，和我一起思索偉大的真理吧。
上帝的威嚴，實在令人心生敬畏...
